dimensions.query: SELECT id, ts, type, value, source FROM telemetry_history WHERE device_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telemetry_history WHERE device_id = ?) AS telemetry,       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log_history       WHERE device_id = ?) AS log,       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_event      WHERE device_id = ?) AS event

INSERT INTO log_conflict
             (conflict_key, device_id, boot_seq, seq, kind, diff_fields,
              existing_fp, incoming_fp, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, seen_count, status)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, unixepoch(), unixepoch(), ?, 'open')
           ON CONFLICT(conflict_key) DO UPDATE SET
             seen_count   = seen_count + excluded.seen_count,
             last_seen_at = unixepoch()

SELECT device_id, state, model, hw_rev, first_seen, last_seen, fw_version, account_deleted_at, created_at, updated_at
               FROM device
              WHERE device_id = ?
              LIMIT ?
UPDATE ui_session SET last_seen_at = ? WHERE sid = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL

SELECT type, ts, value, source, created_at FROM (  SELECT type, ts, value, source, created_at,         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY type ORDER BY ts DESC, id DESC) AS rn    FROM telemetry_history WHERE device_id = ?) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY type

INSERT INTO log_boot_watermark
             (device_id, max_boot_seq, max_seq_at_max, first_seen_at, last_seen_at,
              obs_count, rewind_count, last_rewind_at, last_rewind_boot, updated_at,
              epoch, observed_max_boot_seq, ambiguous_count)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, unixepoch(), unixepoch(), ?, ?,
                   CASE WHEN ? > 0 THEN unixepoch() ELSE NULL END, ?, unixepoch(),
                   1, ?, ?)
           ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO UPDATE SET
             max_seq_at_max = CASE
                 WHEN ? > max_boot_seq THEN ?
                 WHEN ? = max_boot_seq THEN MAX(max_seq_at_max, ?)
                 ELSE max_seq_at_max END,
             max_boot_seq          = ?,
             observed_max_boot_seq = MAX(observed_max_boot_seq, ?),
             ambiguous_count       = ambiguous_count + ?,
             prev_epoch_max        = CASE WHEN ? = 1 THEN NULL ELSE prev_epoch_max END,
             last_seen_at          = unixepoch(),
             obs_count             = obs_count + ?,
             rewind_count          = rewind_count + ?,
             last_rewind_at        = CASE WHEN ? > 0 THEN unixepoch() ELSE last_rewind_at END,
             last_rewind_boot      = CASE WHEN ? > 0 THEN ? ELSE last_rewind_boot END,
             updated_at            = unixepoch()

SELECT device_id, max_boot_seq, max_seq_at_max, rewind_count, epoch, prev_epoch_max, observed_max_boot_seq, ambiguous_count
              FROM log_boot_watermark
             WHERE device_id IN (?)

INSERT INTO device_event (device_id, type, actor, payload, created_at)
             SELECT ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
              WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device d
                             WHERE d.device_id = ? AND d.state <> 'REVOKED')
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_event e
                                 WHERE e.device_id = ? AND e.type = ?
                                   AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.event_id') = ?)
SELECT * FROM command_audit WHERE cmd_id = ? AND device_id = ?

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO telemetry_history
             (device_id, ts, type, value, source, seq, schema_version)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

INSERT INTO device (device_id, state, first_seen, last_seen, fw_version)
             VALUES (?, 'CLAIM_PENDING', ?, ?, ?)
             ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO UPDATE SET
                 -- P1-6（Q11）：**单调**刷新，防乱序覆盖。
                 --   ⚠️ SQLite 标量 MAX(a,b) 任一方为 NULL 即返回 NULL
                 --   ⇒ 必须 COALESCE(last_seen, 0)，否则首见设备（last_seen 为 NULL）会被刷成 NULL。
                 last_seen  = MAX(COALESCE(device.last_seen, 0), excluded.last_seen),
                 fw_version = COALESCE(excluded.fw_version, device.fw_version),
                 updated_at = unixepoch(),
                 -- §4.1：仅允许 FACTORY → CLAIM_PENDING（"被发现"），其余一律不动
                 state      = CASE WHEN device.state = 'FACTORY'
                                   THEN 'CLAIM_PENDING' ELSE device.state END
               -- ★ IT-1：退役设备不刷 last_seen / fw_version / state（条件更新）
               WHERE device.state <> 'REVOKED'

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO log_history
             (device_id, ts, level, code, boot_seq, seq, message, payload)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
SELECT 1 AS hit, ts, level, code, message, payload FROM log_history WHERE device_id = ? AND boot_seq = ? AND seq = ? LIMIT ?

INSERT INTO command_audit (cmd_id, device_id, actor, label, family, action_id, risk, state,  payload_hash, payload_note, request_at, trace_id, unrecoverable) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)
SELECT * FROM device_event WHERE device_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?

INSERT INTO mqtt_messages (device_id,topic,direction,raw_payload,cmd,msg_id,object,stable_id,version,status,status_text,error_code,error_text,msg_type,msg_type_text,message,timestamp,payload_json,created_at,dedup_key) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(dedup_key) WHERE dedup_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
